text:
maya_c: quick update — bringing up atlas-7b-q8 on dedicated clusters in ap-sg and eu-west, ran a short continuous-batching sweep this morning.

sam_w: nice, what config did you test?

maya_c: baseline: batch_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=4096, fairness_weight=0.0; quant=Q8_INT8 path; kernel candidates: flash_attn_v2 vs triton_matmul.

lina_m: curious about p99s — cont-batching can hide tails badly across regions.

maya_c: results (summary):
```
ap-sg (H100, 4x): p50=22ms, p95=68ms, p99=210ms, throughput=920 req/s, tokens/s=180k\neu-west (H100, 6x): p50=19ms, p95=55ms, p99=165ms, throughput=1100 req/s, tokens/s=220k
```

maya_c: flash_attn_v2 gave ~8% better p50 on eu-west but p99 slid ~15% in ap-sg during microburst traffic (we saw spike at 11:43 UTC). triton_matmul is steadier at tail but slightly higher median.

arjun_k: did you try changing fairness_weight? last run we saw small requests starve under max_batch_tokens=4096.

maya_c: yes — with fairness_weight=0.5 (small-request boost): ap-sg p50 up 4ms but p99 down ~30ms and small request QoS improved (latency for <64 token requests halved). throughput dropped ~6%.

sam_w: any quality regressions from Q8 quantization?

maya_c: ran eval harness (instr-follow + rouge/qa sample): small regressions on factual QA — avg F1 down 0.7% vs fp16, some degeneration on numeric reasoning. Not huge but beyond our alert threshold (0.5%).

lina_m: link to the eval run?

benchmark-bot: test run uploaded: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/2145678901-atlas-q8-sweep (artifacts: latency CSV, kernel traces, eval reports).

maya_c: next steps I propose:
- run kernel A/B pinned across regions (flash_attn_v2 vs triton_matmul) under identical traffic for 30m each
- try batch_window_ms=8/12/20 and max_batch_tokens=2048/4096 to map throughput vs tail
- run quantized calibration with 128 sample calibration set (see run id in artifacts)
- add a small-request priority queue (fairness_weight=0.5) can be opt-in per customer

sam_w: +1. I'll spin up the A/B jobs; can you add a tiny canary route in eu-west so we don't disrupt prod?

maya_c: created canary route `atlas-q8-canary` pinned to a single node pool in eu-west. config snippet:
```
route: atlas-q8-canary
model: atlas-7b-q8
pool: eu-west-canary-1
policy:
  batch_window_ms: 12
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  fairness_weight: 0.5
```

lina_m: if A/B shows flash_attn tail issues in ap-sg, maybe we set region routing policy to prefer triton there.

arjun_k: also worth checking KV cache eviction patterns — q8 memory layout changed cache footprint, could cause extra fetches under high concurrency. add cache metrics to the next run.

maya_c: ack, enabling KV cache metrics and kernel-level perf counters. scheduling the A/B now, will post results ~2145679250.

benchmark-bot: scheduled: A/B jobs queued (ids: 2145678901-A, 2145678901-B). ETA 30m. :robot_face:
